name: HRDecoder-CET

architecture.private_representations: unchanged v3 LocalPath and GlobalPath; no teacher-specific clone assignment
head: 1x1Conv128to64 no_bias + channelLayerNorm + GELU
ResidualBlock64 depthwise3 expansion2
1x1Conv64to192 with_bias + PixelShuffle4
reshape to4classes x3actions; FP32 softmax
architecture.cost_scope: excludes original model and non-MAC operations; CET runtime not tested

members: A old HR ensemble including H4

targets.C_unknown: T and every member hard decision incorrect; exclude action KD
targets.oracle_usage: train labels only; not an evaluable deployed teacher; no target or GT input at inference

losses.G: presence-masked squared Dice + .25*(positive-mean BCE + negative-mean BCE), valid sample/class macro
losses.K: GT hard-decision consistent Bernoulli KL, denominator all valid pixels
losses.gradient_route: task to all parameters; action only L/G/head via selected parameter gradients

training.precision: network BF16; probabilities and losses FP32

inference: resize z0 and action logits separately to original image; sigmoid/softmax then transport; strict>.5; no teacher/no onlineH4/noTTA
main_controls_for_future_study: same-capacity ordinary student with T_star target but without CET
limitations: conditional algebra is not observed improvement
in-sample teacher targets and target coverage generalization unknown
newness and top-journal suitability not established
custom split cannot establish official-paper superiority
